verdict.rationale: Gusto's first-party API versioning doc describes date-based versioning and a deprecation timeline that notifies partners when the oldest version is deprecated. It defines a 12-month support window ending in end-of-life, and returns Deprecation, Sunset and Link response headers. The OpenAPI index corroborates that versions are dated (v2026-06-15). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation policy works as documented in practice, and evidence that the same policy covers APIs beyond Embedded Payroll (the API is restricted to partners).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Gusto uses date-based versioning to provide stability while continuously improving our services.
When a new API version is released, the oldest supported version is marked as deprecated. Partners are notified with clear timelines and instructions for upgrading.
Deprecation headers are HTTP headers included in the API response once a version is marked for deprecation
